DESIGN THE DISPOSITION SET (read-only), then two modules under packages/scheduler/src/supersession/, each with its sibling .js bridge (every scheduler subdirectory carries 1:1 bridges; a missing one fails neither tsc nor vitest and breaks only plain Node).

DoD 2 is the subtle one and it has three separate obligations, all easy to half-satisfy:
